corroborationRationale: WV60 is a comparable integrated Samsung FlexWash witness. It independently corroborates the two-instance FL composition and SF system supervision that W1 identified. It does not corroborate AC7-class inter-instance communication as a documented functional behavior. The reduced model is not falsified, but inter_instance_control_communication lacks second-witness functional recurrence.

freezeReadiness.rationale: Two Samsung implementations converge on instance composition and SF without requiring a third domain. AC7/inter-instance comm remains W1-documented only. Human must decide whether that is sufficient for minimal contract freeze.
